title: Introduce staged lint fast-feedback slices and release-smoke gating
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: developer feedback loops on lint and lightweight regressions were costing time. This PR introduces a two-stage lint pipeline that provides near-instant feedback for changed files and shifts full lint and formatting checks to later pipeline stages. It also adds a 'release-smoke' gating step to release automation so releases must pass a small, fast e2e smoke battery before a draft is published.

What this changes (summary):
- New workflow: .github/workflows/lint-staged.yml — runs quick linters (flake8/ruff/tsc-check) only on changed paths detected by git diff against base branch; returns early on trivial changes.
- Keep the existing full lint job but move to a slower pipeline stage with a longer timeout and isolation: .github/workflows/lint-full.yml.
- CI cache TTLs: adjusted cache key patterns and introduced short-lived TTL for per-branch fast caches and longer TTL for shared artifacts (see .github/cache/policies.md). This reduces stale cache hits and avoids large cache growth in the monorepo.
- Release automation: .github/workflows/release.yml updated to require jobs.release-smoke to pass before creating/publishing a release draft. The smoke job performs a minimal set of integration checks (health endpoint, basic model inference path using a small test model, and infra provisioning smoke tasks) to catch obvious regressions earlier.
- Repo hygiene: removed legacy scripts/prepare-commit-hook.sh and replaced with a lightweight staged pre-commit that only runs on developer machines if configured. CI enforces lint-format checks so local hooks are advisory.

Why staged lint?
- Fast feedback for PR authors: changed-file detection reduces the typical lint job from ~6m to <45s for most small PRs.
- Keeps full lint coverage for merging to ensure repo stability.

Checklist (all run/validated):
- [x] Add lint-staged workflow and unit tests for changed-file detection logic.
- [x] Update docs: dev-infra/ci-lint.md with new developer guidance.
- [x] Add cache policy file and update cache keying to include TTL metadata.
- [x] Wire release-smoke into release workflow and verify gating in a dry run.
- [x] Remove legacy pre-commit script and update CONTRIBUTING.md.

How to test locally:
- Run: ./dev/ci-scripts/run-staged-lint.sh --base main --paths src/redwood-client/*.py
- Emulate release smoke: ./dev/ci-scripts/run-release-smoke.sh --env test

Notes and trade-offs:
- Staged lint relies on git-diff heuristics; we added unit tests and a small fallback to run full lint if detection fails.
- Cache TTLs are conservative; we may longitudinally tune them if cache churn is high.
- Release-smoke intentionally keeps scope narrow to avoid blocking legitimate releases; broader e2e coverage remains in nightly pipelines.

Related: Linear ENG-1421 (fast lint pipeline) and ENG-1422 (release smoke automation).
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial staged lint workflow and detection helpers; add cache policy docs and short TTL keys; wire release-smoke job and tests; remove legacy pre-commit and update docs
review_comments: Arjun: Left a note about caching key collision when branch names contain slashes — added a hash-based sanitizer. Lena: Requested a guard in release-smoke to skip for emergency hotfix branches; implemented a skip flag. Noah: Verified staged-lint reduces runtime on sample PRs and approved. CI initially failed a flaky integration test 'integration/db-connection' in run #3; test was re-run and passed; we added a follow-up item to stabilize the test (ENG-1489).
release_notes: Introduce staged lint fast-feedback job and release-smoke gating for release automation; adjust CI cache TTLs and remove deprecated pre-commit hook. Improves dev feedback and reduces CI cost for small PRs.
notes_for_qa: Smoke gate runs a small battery (health check, minimal inference, provision check). QA should verify release workflow is blocked if smoke fails and allowed when smoke passes. See dev-infra/ci-lint.md for local reproduction steps.
observability_changes: Added metric ci.staged_lint.duration_seconds and release.smoke.duration_seconds to pipeline telemetry; dashboards updated in observability/ci-pipelines.json
ci_logs_snippet: lint-staged: collected 12 changed files, ran ruff on 3 files, flake8 on 2 files — duration 38s; full-lint later ran in 8m with cache hit on v2. release-smoke: executed 3 checks (health, infer, infra) — all passed.

notes: Merged after approvals and green CI. Rollout: the staged-lint workflow is enabled for all repo pushes; release-smoke gating will initially be enabled for release/* branches and then widened after one week of telemetry.
